ICAR IVRI Young Professional-II Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IVRI Young Professional-II Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the ICAR IVRI recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the ICAR IVRI recruitment is Young Professional-II. This is a project-based role within the research field.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Young Professional-II post at the Indian Veterinary Research Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Young Professional-II position?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post-graduation/Master degree in specific fields like Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Biochemistry, Microbiology, or an undergraduate degree in Veterinary & Animal Husbandry (B.V.Sc. & A. H.).

faq.question: Q4. Is there any experience required for this role?
faq.answer: While not strictly mandatory, two years of experience in relevant areas such as Biotechnology or Bioinformatics is preferable for the Young Professional-II position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: The age limit for this recruitment is between 21 years and 45 years. Specific age relaxations may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive consolidated emoluments of Rs. 42,000 per month for the Young Professional-II role.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is a Walk-in interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q8. When and where is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 22nd September 2026 at the Indian Veterinary Research Institute, Izatnagar, Uttar Pradesh, 243122.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their recent bio-data, duly filled application, original documents, one photocopy of self-attested marks sheets, degree certificates, experience certificates, and one passport-size photograph.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of the Indian Veterinary Research Institute?
faq.answer: The official website of the Indian Veterinary Research Institute is www.ivri.nic.in. Candidates can visit this site for more information and updates.
